body: Build first (auth itself): admin control of another user's 2FA, email domain allow-list, unknown-device sign-in mail, LDAP sign-in module, SIWE sign-in module, graded log/challenge/block on auth rate rules. Later (peripheral, after the core has no gaps): security event stream and drains, geo-blocking and impossible travel, proof-of-work, stale-account monitoring. No vendor connectors ever; interfaces and hooks only.
title: Owner 2026-10-09: focus on auth itself; build order
